title: Kitchen Timer
summary: Kitchen timer with display, 3 buttons, buzzer and battery

requirements.text: show remaining time with big digits on the display
set minutes/seconds with + / - and start / stop / reset with one button
loud beeping alarm with flashing LED when time is up
runs on LiPo charged from USB, deep sleep after idle, any button wakes it

uses: on the kitchen counter near the stove, powered by battery or USB: set minutes with + / - and start, read big digits across the kitchen
loud beep when time is up, stop with one press, status LED flashes with the beep
in a drawer between uses: sleeps, wakes on any button

options.name: Tilted desk wedge
options.look: small wedge leaning 25 deg, display facing the cook, three buttons below it
options.panel: OLED display centred on lid top, three buttons in a row below it, status LED beside buzzer grille

options.name: Fridge puck
options.look: round puck held by magnets on the fridge, display in centre, ring of buttons
options.panel: display centre, three buttons around bottom arc, buzzer behind grille

options.name: Hand pebble
options.look: pebble held in the hand with lanyard, display on top, buttons on side
options.panel: display on top, buttons on side edge, buzzer at bottom

concept.why: A counter timer is read at a distance while cooking: the tilted wedge faces the display up to the cook and keeps buttons in reach.

firmware.notes: XIAO ESP32-C3, libraries Adafruit GFX + Adafruit SSD1306, flash via Arduino IDE USB-C

check.tool: g++ 14.2.0 compile, no link (arduino-esp32 3.x stubs, Seeed
